subject: website
name: Token4Token
summary: Token4Token, a pay-per-token AI inference marketplace on Gnosis and Swarm, with its source in ffaerber/t4t (no licence file). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads Google Fonts, reads the Gnosis chain through rpc.gnosischain.com and fetches the xBZZ price from api.coingecko.com.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.

connections.name: Gnosis RPC (rpc.gnosischain.com)
connections.note: Chain reads when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: CoinGecko price API (api.coingecko.com)
connections.note: Price fetched when the page opens.
